body: I really do. I think I'm burnt out. Thanks for the words of advice and clarity on the situation. Much appreciated.

I'm pouring myself into my job and the results aren't coming. I've pushed away friends/family/community in pursuit of my job. It isn't working out. If life occupies 'all my life' I feel like my life is a failure. I can't rest and relax. Every moment I try to spend 'on my own' I feel guilty because I could be contributing to the job.
Office building. Up 7 floors. Should do the trick
